'''Bit''' (Japanese: '''ビット''' ''Bit'') is a {{p|Cinderace}} that [[Casey Shield]] owns in [[Pokémon Adventures]] and her sixth {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} overall. He is at [[level]] 35.

==History==
[[File:Casey and Bit.png|thumb|left|150px|Bit and Casey]]
Bit debuted in ''[[PASS01|Wow!! That's One Big Pokémon]]'' as a Scorbunny. He was first seen watching {{Henry}} do maintenance on [[Lancelot]]'s leek. [[PASS02|Later]] that day, he was used in a mock [[Max Raid Battle]] to help teach [[Marvin]] about battling. 

In ''[[PASS03|Chomp!! Defeat Drednaw]]'', [[Professor Magnolia]] accidentally ran over a group of {{p|Drednaw}}, angering them. Scorbunny helped fend off the Bite Pokémon, using his speed to dodge their attacks and giving one a {{status|burn}}. The weakened Drednaw tripped over its ally, causing it to crash into Scorbunny, resulting in a double knockout.

In ''[[PASS04|Zap!! A Rising Beam of Light]]'', a pair of {{tc|Team Yell Grunt}}s tried to destroy the uniforms Casey and Henry received for the [[Galar League|Gym Challenge]]. Henry and Casey knocked the Grunts into a nearby [[Pokémon Den]], forcing them to work together in a Max Raid Battle with a wild {{p|Gurdurr}}. Scorbunny used his flames to heat Gurdurr's steel beam, leaving it too hot to hold. Lancelot defeated the defenseless Gurdurr, allowing Henry to catch it.

In ''[[PASS07|Blinding!! The End of the Battle]]'', Scorbunny was used in Casey's [[Gym]] battle against [[Milo]], where he emerged victorious after a close match.

In ''[[PASS09|Splish Splash!! Gigantamax Battle]]'', Casey was revealed to have won her second Gym battle against [[Nessa]]. Due to Scorbunny [[Evolution|evolving]] into Raboot and Nessa's {{p|Toxapex}} and Drednaw being worn out from their earlier battle with Henry, Raboot was able to win despite the large disadvantage.
[[File:Casey Raboot Sordward and Shielbert battle.png|thumb|120px|left|Bit attacking Sordward and Shielbert's Pokémon]]
In ''[[PASS11|Gulp!! Gulp Pokémon]],'' Casey was approached by [[Hop]], who reported he may have found Casey's missing {{p|Arrokuda}}, Kilo. They rushed to find Kilo, only to find him being swallowed by a wild {{p|Cramorant}}. With help from Hop's {{p|Snorlax}} and {{p|Pincurchin}}, Casey and Raboot freed Kilo and reunited him with his Trainer.

In ''[[PASS15|Shocking!! Reunion in the Forest]]'', Raboot was one of the three Pokémon Casey brought to use in her Gym battle against [[Allister]], where he ended up being defeated.

In ''[[PASS18|Chomp!! It's Dracovish]]'', Raboot was used in Casey's Gym battle against [[Opal]], where he ended up being defeated.

In ''[[PASS19|Crunch!! Snowy Battle]]'', Casey mistakenly believed [[Gordie]] was attacking Henry and Marvin and rushed to defend them. She had Raboot, Twiggy, and Sniffler use a combination attack to defeat Gordie's {{p|Stonjourner}}. They apologized afterward after realizing that Gordie meant no harm.

In ''[[PASS23|Unbending!! Meet the Celebrities]]'', the group was attacked by [[Sordward]] and [[Shielbert]], the thieves who stole Casey's Pokémon. Raboot attacked Sordward's {{p|Golisopod}} and Shielbert's {{p|Bronzong}} with a {{m|Flame Charge}}, destroying the communication devices attached to them. This allowed the group to discover where the brothers were hiding.

In ''[[PASS31|Flutter!! Tickets to a New Land]]'', Casey decided that with her team fully reunited, she would give Raboot the nickname Bit. He was then used to battle [[Klara]]'s {{p|Venipede}}, easily defeating it with a single Flame Charge.

In ''[[PASS34|BAAM!! Incredible Evolution of the Three Pokémon]]'', while Henry was training [[Arman|Kubfu]], it got overwhelmed by a group of wild {{p|Skwovet}} and {{p|Greedent}}. Bit, alongside Twiggy and Sniffler, protected it from the Greedy Pokémon. All three evolved during the fight.

In ''[[PASS41|Shing!! Final Form]]'', Bit was given [[Max Soup]] and gained the ability to [[Gigantamax]]. He was [[PASS42|soon]] after Gigantamaxed to battle a Gigantamaxed {{p|Kingler}}, {{p|Orbeetle}}, and {{p|Sandaconda}} that were protecting {{p|Eternatus}}. With the help of Twiggy, Sniffler, and [[Bede]]'s {{p|Hatterene}}, they were able to distract them long enough for {{p|Zacian}} and {{p|Zamazenta}} to attack the Gigantic Pokémon directly.

==Personality and characteristics==
As a Scorbunny, Bit was generally seen smiling and upbeat. After evolving, he retained his friendliness, though became reserved in his expressions. He tends to get more serious during battles, often lighting the pads of his feet on fire as a Scorbunny. Bit is able to sense when his friends are in trouble, shown when he ran off to help [[Sniffler]] during its fight.

==Trivia==
* Bit is Casey's only Pokémon not to be named after a metric prefix.
* Bit took the longest to evolve out of the Galar [[Pokédex holder]]'s Pokémon, having been a Raboot for 26 chapters.
* Bit is the only Pokémon in [[Pokémon Adventures]] to have used the move {{m|Pyro Ball}}.
